messages:
Ava Nguyen: Morning team — quick platform morning check. What I did: rolled kernel patch for batching engine to reduce stalls on long-context runs. Deployed to dedicated-staging. Blockers: quantized unit tests flaky on 3090 nodes (segfault during matmul). Need help triaging. Today: debug CI, open PR for batch-policy tweak, and request a canary on prod-dedicated if green. Ping @Sam for canary approval. (thanks)
Sam Torres: saw the CI failures this morning, looking into GPU scheduling logs, will post findings in ~30m :eyes:
Ravi Patel: I can re-run the failing tests with debug symbols on a spare 3090 — point me at the job ID? Also noticed recent libcudnn update in images.
Ava Nguyen: job id 48291 — thanks @Ravi. I pushed a quick-repro harness in infra/tests/48291, see snippet: ```bash
python tests/repro.py --job 48291 --device 0
```
Maya Lin: ETA on canary window? If we roll during peak, might affect latency SLOs for a few tenants.
Ava Nguyen: planning canary at 14:15 PT, 15-minute window; will limit to tenant:dedicated-small. If CI green I'll flag for rollout. @Theo can you standby for rollback? :thumbsup:
Theo Ramos: yes, will monitor and have rollback ready. Also will watch traces in console.
eng-deploy-bot: deploy request received for canary: kernel-batch-v2 -> scheduled 14:15 PT (automated check pending)
Sam Torres: found mismatch in cuBLAS flags causing misaligned memory reads — sending PR with patch and test fix. If accepted, re-run CI then canary looks safe.
Ava Nguyen: awesome — @Sam ping me when PR is ready. If green, I'll kick canary. Also need 1 more reviewer for the batching policy PR (PR#4117) — @Maya or @Ravi? 
Maya Lin: I can review PR#4117 after lunch (in ~2h). Quick scan OK from here.
Ravi Patel: will review tests and reproduce log traces after I finish re-run.
Ava Nguyen: thanks all. Quick asks for the broader all-hands: if anyone sees production spike around 14:15 PT, pls call out in #eng-oncall and DM me. I'll post a brief follow-up once canary is complete. :white_check_mark:
Sam Torres: noted. Good luck :crossed_fingers:
Ava Nguyen: end.
